_comment: Voice contract: docs/design/character-profiles.md 'Forge-Tier Smith' (proud/laconic; pride lives in the spec, never in her own skill). The forge tier is reachable ONLY through the elevator_pass_stamped lift, so the base hub IS the post-permit read and no permit-keyed variant is authored -- v0.15 T4.1, CHOICE-LOG.

hub.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
hub.text: Bench is mine until the second bell. Say it quick.

text_variants.text: You put the miscalibrated one down. It had been drifting toward my slab for two shifts. Say what you need.
The Liscor news came up the shaft this morning. Say what you need. I listen better with a hammer in hand.

options.text: Who decides how a thing gets built up here?
[Ask what the seal news cost the tier.]

spec.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
spec.text: A full working day at heat, then it stands down cold. Push it past that and the slab cracks. A cracked slab is a season of paperwork and a smith who doesn't work that season.

options.text: How often does someone push it?
Then I'll stand clear of it.

standard.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
standard.text: The city sets the spec. I hold it. That's the whole arrangement, and it's better than it sounds. Nothing built on this tier fails quietly.

seal.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
seal.text: Something under their stone wanted feeding, and now it doesn't. That's all of it that reached this tier. I'd have liked the measurements.

options.text: It was older than the city over it.
